action_label: Remove the employee from the device
description:
What this is. An employee who has left should not still be able to clock in, and should not keep appearing in your headcount.

What to do. Change their Status to Left, Suspended or Inactive and save. You are asked which machines to remove them from. If they come back and you set them Active again, you are offered the reverse — putting them back on.

Where to find it. Employee, under HR.
name: Take an Employee off the Devices
title: Employee — remove them from the device
